fields.title: What to Move to CDN
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The screen contains: product images, prices, stock levels, category names, personal recommendations, store logos, promotional banner.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: to CDN — product images, logos, promotional banner, category names (change rarely). Do not move — prices (freshness), stock levels (change constantly), recommendations (personal). Technique: does it change between users and how often between requests. For a promotional banner, use a versioned filename, otherwise an ended promotion will linger in the cache for hours.
